MeetingPlbkStageCapability.name: MeetingPlbkStageCapability
MeetingPlbkStageCapability.description: Represents the execution of an action for a meeting playbook stage.

DateProcessed.description: The date when the meeting playbook stage action was processed.

ErrorMessage.description: The error message returned if this capability encountered an error during processing.

LastReferencedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user referenced this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user viewed this record.

MeetingPlaybookStageId.description: The stage in a meeting playbook, created from a meeting playbook definition stage. Defines the stage position, action, and prompts available at the stage.

MtgPlbkDefStgCapabilityId.description: The link between a prompt and a meeting playbook definition stage. Specifies the prompt suggestions at the stage and the task or action.

Name.description: The name of this meeting playbook stage capability.

Status.description: The status of the capability action.
